disclaimer: All statistics computed from real historical backtests (2006-2026 OANDA data; crypto 2016-2026 Coinbase) net of estimated retail costs. Backtested performance does not guarantee future results. Projection bands are block-bootstrap resamples of realised history. Demo/practice capital only — not investment advice.

strategies.name: Blackbox Multi-Edge — Balanced
strategies.tagline: Three independent, validated edges (seasonal equity, commodity trend, macro gold), blended equal-risk.
strategies.method: 3 low-correlation edges (pairwise corr 0.04-0.25), each 20yr-validated with split-half robustness; equal-risk blend, vol-targeted.

strategies.name: Blackbox Multi-Edge — Aggressive
strategies.tagline: The same three-edge engine levered to an 18% volatility target for higher return and drawdown.
strategies.method: Same engine as Balanced at a higher vol target. Leverage amplifies both return and drawdown.

strategies.name: Seasonal Equity
strategies.tagline: Long global stock indices only in an uptrend and in the strong Nov-Apr season; cash otherwise.
strategies.method: 8 indices; entries require >200-day MA AND Nov-Apr (Halloween effect). Both rules pre-specified, robust in both decade-halves.

strategies.name: Macro Gold
strategies.tagline: Holds gold only when gold trends up AND falling yields give it a macro tailwind.
strategies.method: Gold>200dMA AND US10Y bond>100dMA. Zero-yield real-asset mechanism; conditional Sharpe 1.10, halves 1.00/1.22 over 20yr.

strategies.name: Commodity Trend
strategies.tagline: Rides uptrends across 12 commodities (metals, energy, grains); flat in downtrends.
strategies.method: Long-only 200-day-MA trend, equal-weight across commodities. Diversifier: low correlation to equities.

strategies.name: Global Risk Parity
strategies.tagline: Owns everything — 36 global markets weighted so each contributes equal risk.
strategies.method: Inverse-volatility weights across FX, bonds, commodities, indices. The diversified-beta benchmark (Sharpe ~0.5 over 20yr).

strategies.name: Crypto Momentum
strategies.tagline: Long liquid crypto majors in uptrends, 100% cash in crypto winters. High octane.
strategies.method: 200-day-MA trend on 13 majors, inverse-vol, 35% vol target. Backtest Sharpe ~1.2 BUT one bull regime + survivorship caveats; expect less.

strategies.name: S&P 500 Buy & Hold
strategies.tagline: The benchmark: own the index through everything, including -50% crashes.
strategies.method: Reference strategy for comparison. Full equity beta and full equity drawdowns.
